role: quant-auditor (fresh context, adversarial, audit-only; no execution performed)
verdict_basis: 3 unresolved HIGH findings (F-1, F-2, F-3). The chain is unusually disciplined in its engine code, GO gating and disclosures, but the plan's own fail-closed laws are breached at three named gates: the D1 freeze is missing a plan-required field (with the checker written blind to it), the scored-path harness cannot compute a named member of the Stage-A battery whose terminal outcome name asserts it, and the M0 phase was satisfied with a predecessor cycle's 10-gate artifact instead of the plan's 11/11 + dual-books fixture. All three are remediable before GO; none requires touching scored cells.

findings.section: D1 freeze vs plan §5 required fields (§4 F4 financing derivation)
evidence: plans/PLAN_forex_search_v1.md ¥5: 'The hashed manifest is REQUIRED to contain, fail-closed (a missing field is a D1 freeze failure): ... and the §4 F4 financing derivation printed verbatim with its caveats'

research/control/forex_search_v1_run/d1/search_space_manifest.json: contains NO financing/cost field anywhere (no '1.7', no '9.4', no derivation text); line 'plan_sections_frozen': ["§3b", "§4 F3", "§4 F4", "§5", "§6", "§8"] falsely claims §4 F4 is frozen in it; the only financing trace is a digest REFERENCE inside source_artifacts.digests_verified_against_p0_gate

research/control/forex_search_v1_run/d1/build_d1_manifest.py lines 609-622: cost_financing_block() builds exactly the required verbatim block but is DEAD CODE — build_manifest() (lines 627-757) loads cf = art['cost_financing_manifest.json'] and never calls it

research/control/forex_search_v1_run/d1/build_d1_manifest.py lines 855-868: the selfcheck's own 'required plan fields present' list omits the financing block, so the checker was written blind to the omission and passes
findings.why: The plan declares a missing required field a D1 FREEZE FAILURE, fail-closed. The manifest is 'this cycle's A2-equivalent dossier'; the financing derivation and its caveats (3-night average does not bound the worst night; NZD-USD-worst generalized to five legs) are load-bearing owner disclosures for the exact scored cells about to be authorized. The freeze fails its own law and misreports its coverage.
findings.required_remediation: Rebuild D1 with cost_financing_block(cf) actually embedded (the function already exists), correct or justify plan_sections_frozen, extend the selfcheck required-fields list to include the block, re-freeze, then cascade: S re-walk (outcome-blind, unchanged arms expected) with updated manifest shas, i_engine FREEZE_SHA256 re-pin, Z re-run (its scanner pins source segments/digests). Re-hash and re-verify the whole citation chain before any GO.

findings.section: Stage-A battery integrity: DSR (N=33, alpha 0.10) and P-11 persistence absent from the scored-path harness
evidence: plans/PLAN_forex_search_v1.md §6: 'Plus the frozen forex Stage-A gates on any survivor (UNCHANGED, §3): fold-positive-share, concentration, MDD, stress margin, drop-one, per-period series persisted (P-11) for DSR with N = frozen grid size at alpha 0.10 (owner-relaxed) AND program-cumulative ~260 at alpha 0.05 (reported, not gating)'; §3 ledger relaxes 'DSR deflation set N -> frozen grid size' and 'DSR alpha -> 0.10' as axes of the acceptance battery

research/control/forex_search_v1_run/i/adjudicate.py: Stage-A implements fold_positive_share, concentration, mdd, stress_margin, drop_one, pit_mutation — NO DSR computation, NO P-11 per-period series persistence; a recursive search of research/control/forex_search_v1_run finds 'dsr/deflated' only in disclosure strings and D1's N=33 declaration

research/control/forex_search_v1_run/i/adjudicate.py adjudicate_cycle(): emits outcome 'FOREX_SEARCH_V1_SURVIVORS_UNDER_RELAXED_BATTERY_R0_NOT_RUN_PBO_NOT_RUN' on Stage-A PASS — an outcome name asserting the relaxed battery, which the harness cannot in principle have run
research/control/forex_search_v1_run/z/dry_run_report.json: Stage-A rows contain no DSR subgate
findings.why: An arm that passes R1-R6 + current Stage-A would be declared a survivor 'UNDER_RELAXED_BATTERY' with the battery's DSR leg (N=33, alpha 0.10 — the exact statistic the owner grant relaxed) never computed and no per-period series persisted for reproduction. The terminal outcome name would assert a battery membership it did not run; the §10 result language would inherit the same defect.
findings.required_remediation: Add DSR computation to Stage-A (N=33 at alpha 0.10 gating/reporting per the plan's own reading, plus program-cumulative ~260 at alpha 0.05 reported) and persist the per-period (P-11) series artifact, before GO. Alternatively obtain an explicit, registered owner/plan amendment that re-scopes DSR out of Stage-A — silently omitting it is not available.

findings.section: M0 gate contract drift: plan §9 M0 (G1-G10 + G4N = 11/11 + dual-books degenerate fixture, under m0/, before D1) not executed as specified
evidence: plans/PLAN_forex_search_v1.md §9 M0 row: 'methodology golden suite (G1-G10 + G4N = 11/11, NG5/NG6/NG7 lineage) re-inherited BYTE-EXACT + the dual-books degenerate fixture (the uniform-charge financed book must not invert sign vs price-only on any fixture arm) — re-run under research/control/forex_search_v1_run/m0/; PASS required before D1'

research/control/forex_search_v1_run/m0/m0_verdict.json: cycle_id 'FOREX-NG6', gate 'M0 (plans/PLAN_forex_ng6.md §3)', output lists only G1-G10 and prints 'M0 PASS (10 gates)' — no G4N, no dual-books fixture, and the artifact self-identifies as a predecessor cycle's gate
research/control/forex_search_v1_run/m0/test_m0_golden.py: gate functions g1..g10 only

G4N (negative control on payoff-contaminated verdict paths) exists NOWHERE in this cycle; the dual-books fixture exists only later and in different lanes (tests/test_forex_search_v1_i.py 'test_dual_books_rule_wrapper' et al., Z checks C1-C4)
findings.why: The plan names M0 as a gate with specific content and timing ('PASS required before D1'). The chain's M0 evidence is a different (weaker, predecessor) gate, and no artifact discloses the delta. The cycle-specific half of the fixture (financed-book sign invariance — the plan's own audit item #1 class) was eventually exercised in I/Z, which mitigates but does not cure the undisclosed gate substitution; G4N-class negative coverage for verdict-path contamination was never established in this cycle.
findings.required_remediation: Before GO: either (a) run the plan-specified M0 under m0/ (11/11 incl. G4N + the dual-books degenerate fixture) and commit the verdict, or (b) record an explicit disclosed plan-deviation note citing owner authority, enumerating exactly what ran instead and where (I/Z dual-books fixtures; G4N inapplicability to this cycle's adjudicate.py verdict path). Silence is not an option; the current artifacts present an NG6 gate as if it discharged this cycle's §9 M0 row.

findings.section: P0 F1(iii) repull artifact: summary flag contradicts its own per-leg verdicts
evidence: research/control/forex_search_v1_run/p0/f1_repull_result.json: 'any_divergence_or_unreachable': false while all five legs carry verdict 'DIVERGENCE' (diff_count 2-3 each)

research/control/forex_search_v1_run/p0/f1_repull.py line ~163: result['any_divergence_or_unreachable'] = not ok_all, where ok_all is only flipped on VENDOR_UNREACHABLE / NO_OVERLAP — never on DIVERGENCE
findings.why: The flag's name promises divergence detection but the code only tracks unreachability. A downstream or owner reader consuming the flag would conclude the vendor serves byte-identical history, which is false. The per-leg verdicts and p0_gate F1(iii) PASS_WITH_DISCLOSURE are honest and the archive-remains-authority law is stated, so the gate conclusion itself is unaffected.
findings.required_remediation: Fix the flag semantics (or rename it any_unreachable_or_no_overlap), regenerate the result artifact, and disclose the correction; verify nothing consumes the mislabeled field.

findings.section: D1 manifest frozen-text defect on a SELECTED scored arm (MONTHPOS-SECOND state_formula self-contradiction)
evidence: research/control/forex_search_v1_run/d1/search_space_manifest.json (FSS-CLOCK-COND-MONTHPOS-SECOND-LONG and -SHORT): 'state_formula': 'state = (day-of-month of the decision date D <= 15) = (day-of-month >= 16) — MONTHPOS day<=15 boundary PIN (P0 pin #3)' — the first clause states the FIRST-half boundary inside the SECOND-half arm's formula

research/control/forex_search_v1_run/s/selection_freeze.json: the contradictory excerpt is carried VERBATIM into the rank-1 arm's config_manifest_excerpt_verbatim and thence into the arm identity hash

research/control/forex_search_v1_run/p0/p0_census.py state_clock_cond: hit = first_half if monthpos == 'FIRST' else (not first_half) — engine implements day>=16 correctly; census totals FIRST 11975 + SECOND 12330 = 24305 = complementary coverage, confirming the engine reading
findings.why: The manifest is the construction dossier of record ('the manifest IS this cycle's A2-equivalent dossier'); a selected scored arm whose frozen formula text contradicts itself is a freeze-integrity defect even though the engine, census arithmetic and mechanism statement all agree on day>=16. A detached reproducer reading the text alone cannot resolve the construction.
findings.required_remediation: Correct the state_formula string (and the family template if implicated) in D1 and re-freeze with the same cascade as F-1; alternatively annotate the erratum explicitly in the manifest and the S freeze. Do not leave a self-contradictory construction string on a scored arm.

findings.section: §4 F5 fired-rate form: selected arms sit 4-9x above the placeholder band; the 'measured value replaces the form' substitution was never explicitly pinned
evidence: research/control/forex_search_v1_run/p0/p0_gate.json fired_rate_form_evaluation: all three selected arms (MONTHPOS-SECOND, OPEN-GAP-CONFIRM-Q50, VOL-DRIFT-MOM-L63) are false in every fold vs the [0.02, 0.10] bars/leg/day form; measured pooled fold-3 fired rates are ~0.50, ~0.90, ~0.51 bars/leg/day
research/control/forex_search_v1_run/p0/fired_census.json form_note: 'membership reported here is the FORM evaluation only'; fail-closed floors (pooled >= 30/fold) pass everywhere

plans/PLAN_forex_search_v1.md §4 F5: 'the recent-window measured value replaces the form before selection' — no artifact pins that substitution decision or value before the S walk; the phase 'P2' named by F5 does not exist in this cycle's §9 chain
findings.why: Reading F5's band as a hard gate would render all three selected arms infeasible and change the cycle's outcome; reading it as a replaced form (as the census discloses) makes the selection valid. The plan's letter supports the replacement reading and the fail-closed population floors are satisfied, so this is not a violation — but the substitution's discretion (always-on arms up to 90% of leg-days entering a 3-cell scored budget) deserves an owner-visible flag rather than an implicit one.
findings.required_remediation: Disclose explicitly at the GO gate that the F5 form band was superseded by measured fired rates per the census form_note, with the three arms' measured rates printed; no code change required.

findings.section: Data authority input audit: 97 weekend-dated bars in the master calendar, disclosed but unexplained
evidence: research/control/forex_search_v1_run/p0/p0_gate.json F1(v): weekend_dates_in_master 97 (weekday-6: 62, weekday-7: 35) of master_len 4924; weekday counts sum to 4924 (verified)
research/control/forex_search_v1_run/p0/manifest_pin.json + structural_census: vendor serves date-only stamps; the frozen stamp convention accepts vendor dates as the completed session
findings.why: Weekend-dated daily bars on a 16:00-NY clock are anomalous for these five pairs and they participate in fold thirds, warmup alignment, OPEN-GAP 252-gap windows and DOW/MONTHPOS state formation. The census counts them honestly and the convention law covers them, so no gate fails — but an input-audit trail should note the anomaly rather than let it travel silently.
findings.required_remediation: Add one disclosed sentence to the P0/GO materials identifying which legs/dates the weekend bars come from and confirming they are vendor-served session bars under the frozen stamp convention; exclude nothing silently.

findings.section: ≤3-cell budget and DSR N enforcement are structural, not explicit harness counters
evidence: research/control/forex_search_v1_run/i/i_engine.py: FROZEN_ARMS (3), verify_positions_vs_freeze() raises INPUT_MISMATCH for any config outside the frozen selections; s/selection_freeze.json walk.budget max_cells 3 / max_cells_per_family 2
No E-phase runner exists in the repository yet (correct pre-GO state); no numeric budget counter guards it because it is unwritten
findings.why: The freeze membership check functionally enforces 'only the 3 frozen arms', but the ≤3-cell law will bind only through E-runner discipline at GO time. Not a defect of the frozen chain; recorded so the constraint is carried into the GO conditions rather than assumed.
findings.required_remediation: Carried as GO conditions C-2/C-3 below; the E runner must construct exactly the three frozen arms, call verify_positions_vs_freeze() before any book, and consume at most 3 observed slots under the machine-wide heavy lock.
